liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Eleven** (3 reviews): The performance of The Eleven is described as phenomenal; The Eleven is highlighted as causing intense physical and emotional reactions [5][10][14]
- **Alligator** (2 reviews): The jam sequence starting with Alligator is noted as flawless; The Alligator to Caution transition is considered one of the best ever played [5][6]

## The recordings

- **gd69-02-28.sbd.16track.kaplan.3397.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 166 min; rated 4.5/5 by 48 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is top-notch, originally captured for the Live Dead album but unused; The sound is just about studio quality, with lush and layered playing; Master reels offer a sonic upgrade over the previously circulated alternate cassette soundboard [4][7][13][14]
- **gd1969-02-28.139196.sbd.2track.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1969-02-28.132672.sbd.multi.track.healy-latvala-wise.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 165 min; rated 4.3/5 by 10 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer prefers this performance over the other shows from the 2/27-3/2 run [4]
- Reviewer thinks the 2/27 show is overrated, despite its Live/Dead appearance [8]
- This is the reviewer's favorite show from that era [8]
- Dick Latvala identifies this as the best and most exciting Grateful Dead show ever [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-02-28.sbd.16track.kaplan.3397.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Transferred from 16-track master reel via DAT, CD, and EAC to SHN; File passed through Charlie Miller, Aoxoa, and Seth Kaplan before upload [1]
- **gd1969-02-28.139196.sbd.2track.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Provided by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; SBD > 2-track Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1969-02-28.132672.sbd.multi.track.healy-latvala-wise.flac16**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Dick Latvala and Jim Wise; source: flac16/48kHz ; Ampex MM-1000 16 Track Master Reels Two Inch Wide Tape @ 15 ips; Multi Track Mix-down To a Sony PCM 1630 By Dan Healy @ 44.1KHz); Set #1 DAT x… [3]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - Fillmore West 1969-02-28 5LP](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/51569619903/) [17]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/51569619903/) [18]
